27:     /// then that association will have higher precedence, and the mapping will

14: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
15: pub struct IgnoredSuffixes<'a> {
16:     values: Vec<&'a str>,
17: }
18: 
19: impl Default for IgnoredSuffixes<'_> {
20:     fn default() -> Self {
21:         Self {
22:             values: vec![
23:                 // Editor etc backups
24:                 "~",
25:                 ".bak",
26:                 ".old",
27:                 ".orig",
28:                 // Debian and derivatives apt/dpkg/ucf backups
29:                 ".dpkg-dist",
30:                 ".dpkg-old",
31:                 ".ucf-dist",
32:                 ".ucf-new",
33:                 ".ucf-old",
34:                 // Red Hat and derivatives rpm backups
35:                 ".rpmnew",
36:                 ".rpmorig",
37:                 ".rpmsave",
38:                 // Build system input/template files
39:                 ".in",
40:             ],
41:         }
42:     }
43: }
44: 
45: impl<'a> IgnoredSuffixes<'a> {
46:     pub fn add_suffix(&mut self, suffix: &'a str) {
47:         self.values.push(suffix)
48:     }
49: 
50:     pub(crate) fn values(&self) -> &[&'a str] {
51:         &self.values
52:     }
53: 
54:     pub fn strip_suffix(&self, file_name: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {
55:         for suffix in self.values.iter() {
56:             if let Some(stripped_file_name) = file_name.strip_suffix(suffix) {
57:                 return Some(stripped_file_name);
58:             }
59:         }
60:         None
61:     }
62: 
63:     /// If we find an ignored suffix on the file name, e.g. '~', we strip it and
64:     /// then try again without it.
65:     pub fn try_with_stripped_suffix<T, F>(&self, file_name: &'a OsStr, func: F) -> Result<Option<T>>
66:     where
67:         F: Fn(&'a OsStr) -> Result<Option<T>>,
68:     {
69:         if let Some(file_str) = Path::new(file_name).to_str() {
70:             if let Some(stripped_file_name) = self.strip_suffix(file_str) {
71:                 return func(OsStr::new(stripped_file_name));
72:             }
73:         }
74:         Ok(None)
75:     }
76: 
77:     pub(crate) fn get_syntax_for<'s>(
78:         &self,
79:         assets: &'s HighlightingAssets,
80:         language: Option<&str>,
81:         input: &mut OpenedInput<'_>,
82:         mapping: &SyntaxMapping<'a>,
83:     ) -> Result<SyntaxReferenceInSet<'s>> {
84:         if let Some(language) = language {
85:             let syntax_set = assets
86:                 .syntax_set_cell
87:                 .get_or_try_init(|| assets.serialized_syntax_set.deserialize())?;
88:             return syntax_set
89:                 .find_syntax_by_token(language)
90:                 .map(|syntax| SyntaxReferenceInSet { syntax, syntax_set })
91:                 .ok_or_else(|| Error::UnknownSyntax(language.to_owned()));
92:         }
93: 
94:         let path = input
95:             .metadata
96:             .user_provided_name
97:             .as_ref()
98:             .or(match input.kind {
99:                 OpenedInputKind::OrdinaryFile(ref path) => Some(path),
100:                 _ => None,
101:             });
102: 
103:         let path_syntax = if let Some(path) = path {
104:             let path = PathAbs::new(path)
105:                 .map_or_else(|_| path.to_owned(), |p| p.as_path().to_path_buf());
106: 
107:             let match_mappings = |path: &Path| {
108:                 let candidate = Candidate::new(path);
109:                 let candidate_filename = path.file_name().map(Candidate::new);
110:                 for entry in mapping.mappings().iter().rev() {
111:                     let entry = MappingEntry::from_tuple(entry);
112:                     if entry.glob_matcher().is_match_candidate(&candidate)
113:                         || candidate_filename.as_ref().map_or(false, |filename| {
114:                             entry.glob_matcher().is_match_candidate(filename)
115:                         })
116:                     {
117:                         return Some(*entry.target());
118:                     }
119:                 }
120:                 None
121:             };
122: 
123:             let syntax_match = match_mappings(&path);
124: 
125:             if let Some(MappingTarget::MapToUnknown) = syntax_match {
126:                 Err(Error::UndetectedSyntax(path.to_string_lossy().into()))
127:             } else if let Some(MappingTarget::MapTo(syntax_name)) = syntax_match {
128:                 assets
129:                     .find_syntax_by_name(syntax_name)?
130:                     .ok_or_else(|| Error::UnknownSyntax(syntax_name.to_owned()))
131:             } else {
132:                 let file_name = path.file_name().unwrap_or_default();
133:                 let mut file_name_syntax = assets.find_syntax_by_extension(Some(file_name))?;
134:                 if file_name_syntax.is_none() {
135:                     if let Some(file_str) = Path::new(file_name).to_str() {
136:                         for suffix in self.values() {
137:                             if let Some(stripped_file_name) = file_str.strip_suffix(*suffix) {
138:                                 file_name_syntax = assets.get_syntax_for_file_name(
139:                                     OsStr::new(stripped_file_name),
140:                                     &mapping.ignored_suffixes,
141:                                 )?;
142:                                 break;
143:                             }
144:                         }
145:                     }
146:                 }
147: 
148:                 match (file_name_syntax, syntax_match) {
149:                     (Some(syntax), _) => Ok(syntax),
150:                     (_, Some(MappingTarget::MapExtensionToUnknown)) => {
151:                         Err(Error::UndetectedSyntax(path.to_string_lossy().into()))
152:                     }
153:                     _ => assets
154:                         .get_syntax_for_file_extension(file_name, &mapping.ignored_suffixes)?
155:                         .ok_or_else(|| Error::UndetectedSyntax(path.to_string_lossy().into())),
156:                 }
157:             }
158:         } else {
159:             Err(Error::UndetectedSyntax("[unknown]".into()))
160:         };
161: 
162:         match path_syntax {
163:             Err(Error::UndetectedSyntax(path)) => {
164:                 let syntax_set = assets
165:                     .syntax_set_cell
166:                     .get_or_try_init(|| assets.serialized_syntax_set.deserialize())?;
167:                 String::from_utf8(input.reader.first_line.clone())
168:                     .ok()
169:                     .and_then(|l| syntax_set.find_syntax_by_first_line(&l))
170:                     .map(|syntax| SyntaxReferenceInSet { syntax, syntax_set })
171:                     .ok_or(Error::UndetectedSyntax(path))
172:             }
173:             other => other,
174:         }
175:     }
176: }
